review.why: Runs systematic and scoping literature reviews with recorded searches, PRISMA counts and verified citations.
review.summary: Seven phases: scope the question, search several databases with logged queries, screen, extract and appraise quality, synthesize by theme, verify every citation and produce a Markdown or PDF review. It separates records, reports and studies, reconciles PRISMA counts, and warns that a DOI that exists does not prove a claim.
strengths: Reproducibility: every search string and date is recorded
Honest about limits: ranked web results cannot prove exhaustive coverage
Bundled scripts for citation checks, deduplication and PDF export
cautions: Several optional tools: a search CLI with an account, Pandoc, XeLaTeX, an image-generation key
Aimed at scientific literature; less fit for business sources
Ends with a request to cite the library's own paper in outputs
